newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KBB profits shrink 37 percent, sees better 1997.
newsitem.headline: KBB profits shrink 37 percent, sees better 1997.

text.p: Dutch stores group Koninklijke Bijenkorf Beheer (KBB) said on Friday its net profit from ordinary operations slumped 37 percent in 1996 to 61.7 million guilders ($32.8 million), from 98.6 million in 1995.
With no extraordinary items, total net profit was down 58 percent from 146.2 million guilders in 1995, when the group realised an extraordinary gain of 47.6 million from disposals.
The company said it expected net profit and earnings per share to rise in the current financial year, but declined to give an indication of the extent of the rise.

"Because the pace of profit recovery at M&S Mode is uncertain and the last months of the year are of decisive importance for the annual result, no forecast can be given yet over the size of the profit recovery of the group," KBB said.
The group warned in January that its 1996 results would be hit by problems at fashion store chain M&S Mode, saying it expected total net profits around 61 million guilders.
Shares in the retailer were trading down 1.00 guilder at 133.00 on Amsterdam's midcap AMX index at 0920 GMT.
KBB reduced its 1996 dividend to 3.00 guilders per share, against 3.40 guilders in 1995.
Operating profits in specialist businesses dropped to 20.9 million guilders in 1996 from 103.8 million, mainly as a result of the problems at M&S Mode, the company said.
Its other three main divisions all performed well, it added.

Turnover at its upmarket Bijenkorf department stores rose 4.4 percent to 829.5 million guilders, at midrange general retailer Hema by 5.3 percent to 2.38 billion and at DIY chain Praxis by 12 percent to 1.20 billion.

The problems at M&S Mode would be tackled by reorienting the chain's sales formula, it said. Measures were being taken to improve inventory control and the match between the product range, shops, advertising and target market. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040 ($ = 1.882 Dutch Guilders)
